answer: Each work slot in the orchard costs a deposit that burns when the slot is abandoned or its output is judged fake. A newcomer posts 50 POA for one slot and wears a saffron badge visible to all. The deposit sits in a basalt ledger entry that cannot be transferred, so bought identities carry no history. Forging 100 agents burns 5,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and earns fees from one slot, so honest work stays cheap and forgery stays ruinous.
